description: Type scale measured from the reference's real .heading-style-* utilities (not base element rules), reproduced in tailwind.config.js. Font families: Archivo (self-hosted, SIL OFL, substituted for a commercial grotesque by measured advance-width comparison) and IBM Plex Mono (exact match, self-hosted, SIL OFL).

sans.note: Substitute for the reference's commercial PP Neue Montreal — chosen by measurement: 3.69% mean advance-width deviation / 5.21% worst case across a 7-string sample, best of 10 free grotesques tested (Inter placed last at 9.98%). See README.md:62-67.

mono.note: Exact match to the reference's mono face — no substitution needed.

headingScale.description: Taken from .heading-style-* utilities. All weight 500, line-height .95, letter-spacing -.03em at the base (desktop) tier unless noted. Breakpoint step-downs are documented per-level in typography-responsive.json.

h4.note: Same computed size as h2 on this site — verified, not a copy-paste error in this ledger.

bodyScale.description: Flat 1.3 line-height ratio measured on the original (Tailwind's own defaults of 1.5/1.75/1.4 were being overridden).
